tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed dang lha chen tshogs bdag sbags sgrub kyi mchod bskang gtor tho dbang chen dpal 'bar bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed dang / lha chen tshogs bdag sbags sgrub la/ gtor bsngo dang bskang ba'i rigs sgrigs ngos rang nas sbyar ba'i bran g.yog yid 'phrog dbang gi rgyal po gtong tshul gyi deb tho bkod par/ bshoms kyi skabs su gzhan tshang ma gzhung bzhin la/ tsam bre re las grub pa'i 'byung 'dul la zlum gtor dkar po dang / tshogs bdag gi rgyun gtor zlum po smug rtsis byugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang sha mar gyi brgyan pa mtheb dkyus bskor ba tshogs bdag gi rten bcos tshul la/ bla ma gong ma'i lugs dang / bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi lugs gnyis las/ bla ma gong ma'i lugs ni be'u bum gyi bsham bes gdong mnan pa'i dpe ris lhan cig 'byung ba 'di yin la/ bla ma phyi ma'i lugs ni deng sang rjes gnang la mdzad pa 'di yin kyang / 'dir bla ma gong ma'i lugs byed rgyur bre re las grub pa'i zan ril gsum gyi gnyis gral sgrigs pa'i steng cig shing gzer sogs kyi dam du grags la gsum char smug rtsis byugs pa la mar rgyan sogs dpe ris nas 'byung ba bzhin/ mda' rgod sgro mar dar dmar gyi gtor gdugs bcas gtsug gtor ma 'di gsum sha chang chu mar sogs kyis sbrus la gtor rdzas spyir bdud rtsi ril bu tshogs bdag gi gtor ma gnyis la khyad par gyi rdzas grub chen nag po spyod pas gtor chog nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim par/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin brlabs/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems rnams bde mchog bzhin la/ sems bskyed kyi tshig dmigs bsal tsam khyad yin/ tshogs zhing gi mchod pa'i 'go'i mtshan sngags dang / mjug gi pra titstsha swāhā/ mchod pa thams cad la sbyor/

bdag bskyed mchod bstod la phyag rgya las dril bsil dang rol mo dngos su mi mdzad/ mdun bskyed 'byung 'dul gyi mchod pa la/ rgyas par na stong gsum ma'i gdangs ring / bsdu na gdangs thung / shin du bsdu na shur ma/ nang mchod kyi 'gor bdud rtsi byin brlabs ma byung yang chog pas 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pa sogs rgyun bzhin dang / 'di skabs 'go nas 'byung ba'i tshogs bdag gi sngags tshan bzhi zhes pa ni gzungs ring ma gtogs pa'i sngags mtshan bzhi yin/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba rdzogs nas 'byung 'dul gyi bstod 'gor bcom dril mi byed par hūm̐ zag med bde ba'i sogs bstod pa la btsan 'jus ngos ma lus sems can ma'i gdangs thung dril bsil byed/ 'das gtor byin brlabs nang mchod bzhin la/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba ḍaṃ ga rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba gtor ma la thim zhes bsgyur/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod kyi shapta la rol chen/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nang mchod/ bstod pa 'bar ma'i sku can shlau ka gnyis la dril bsil gdangs bcas/ tshogs bdag gi rten gtor ma dmigs nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang sngags na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bhyoḥnas khaṃ swāhā bar lan gsum sogs ci rigs/ bris sku sumbha nis sbyangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ bskyed chog gzhung bzhin/ tshogs kyi bdag po la thim zhes pa'i rjes su dril bu rgyun dkrol nar ma dang rdo rjer g.yab/ lag sor la grangs bzung ba sogs kyi sgo nas sngags lan nyer gcig brjod/ dril bsil gzhag nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥnas bzung dbu brgyan par gzhung bzhin/ mchod pa byin rlabs 'byung 'dul gyi mdun bskyed bzhin mchod pa'i tshigs bcad skabs pang par khu tshur steng 'og du bzhag nas rgyas par na mchod yon zhabs bsil rol mo rnams la dri med yid 'ong ma'i gdangs ring me tog nas zhal zas kyi bar la gdangs thung / bsdu na thams cad la gdangs thung /

shin du bsdu na shur ma/ shapta'i bar rol chen/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i nang mchod bstod pa dril bsil gdangs bcas 'jig rten mdzad ma rdzogs bskul mtshams yang rgyal ba'i sku gsung sogs bskul la bstod pa rdzogs nas tshogs bdag rgyun gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bul tshul dang phyi nang gi mchod pa gzhung bzhin la shaptar rol chen/ bstod pa dril bsil gdangs bcas thal sbyar gyi phrin 'chol/ bzlas pa'i skabs sumbha ni dang tshogs bdag gi sngags 'bru drug ma 'phreng 'khor/ gzhan gsum so so nas nyer gcig re gzungs ring gsum bcas bzla rgyu la phreng 'khor gnyis shub bu gzhan rnams 'ur 'don/ bzlas bsham gyi 'phrin bcol rdzogs nas bum bskyed rdzogs mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang / bstod pa rnams byed tshul 'byung 'dul gtor 'bul 'jug bzhin/ sumbha ni phreng 'khor/ khrus sngags nyer gcig bum bskyed rdzogs nas khrus gsol la langs nas/ zhwa gyon khrus kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags la gdangs dril bsil rol chen sogs phyag len bzhin/ sku phrin las kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags la gdangs bcas byas la/ zhwa phud nas gral la 'khod/ bcom dril dang ma lus sems can ma'i gdangs thung bcas maṇḍal 'dab brgyad la bkod pa'i zas sna gter bum rin chen sna bdun rnams 'bul bar dmigs nas/ me tog phreng ba zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ thal sbyar gyi yan lag bdun pa gsum bya ba'i dang por lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi gdangs/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa 'dur shur gang rung bcom dril med pa'i bstod pa/ dril bsil gdangs bcas kyi mkha' ltar dag la phyag 'tshal lo la bskul mtshams/ yang rin chen me tog zhes sogs nas bskul zhi byed shog bar tshogs bdag gi rten gtor 'byung 'dul gyi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/

spyan gzigs sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs la bcom dung btang / bcom ring gur mgon bswo ring bzhin la rkang gling med pa'i shlau ka dang po la bswo ring gi dbyangs rol gnyis pa dang gsum par de'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo/ bzhi pa'i lha chen 'khor bcas sogs dang / lnga pa'i tshe dang longs spyod sogs la tshig rol/ tshig rol rjes ma'i rjes su chems brdung sgang dung / sngags lan bdun/ gdan 'bul gyi mthar tshig rol chems brdung / rol skor 'bebs bcas 'bul sngags kyi nang gi mchod pa 'phrin bcol rnams byed tshul gur zhal sogs kyi bskang ba bzhin/ mchod 'bul tshigs rkang bcu gsum la mgon po 'khor dang ma'i mchod dbyangs/ bdag pos yongs su nas 'dur shur gang rung / mthun rdzas 'bul ba shlau ka gcig la dus gsum bde gshegs ma'i dbyangs rol sbrel mtshams rnams su wa yā oṃ mo/ zhes sbyar/ gzhan yang mchod pa sogs shlau ka gcig la nag po mchod rten gyi rnam gzhag tshogs gtor ma'i dbyangs rol oṃ zhes sbyar la/ spu sdug dbyibs legs sogs shlau ka gcig la mdzes pa'i spu sdug ma'i dbyangs rol oṃ zhes sbyar la/ de ltar mchod pa shlau ka gcig la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs rol sbrel mtshams rnams su wa yā oṃ mo zhes sbyar/ bdag cag yon mchod nas 'dur shur gang rung / ci ste 'grub par ma gyur na la rol mo blangs la/ ci nas sogs tshigs rkang gsum pa sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma rgyas pa'i phrin bcol mjug bzhin rol mo/ gzhan yang nas 'dur shur gang rung / bskal pa'i sogs la tshig rol/ zhwa gyon la bstod pa bya ste/ 'di'i bstod ring dang / lha mo'i til mar ma gnyis tshigs rkang 'dra ba las/ 'di tshig bcu bdun dang / til mar mar bcu dgu yod pas/ 'dir til mar ma'i dbyangs 'jug rgyur/ rnga g.yog 'phog mtshams bcu pa nas dal du btang bas/ til mar ma'i dbyangs chug cig

shlau ka gcig la dbyangs byed rgyu bcas/ dbyangs rdzogs mtshams kyi rol len thang gnyis dgos/ paṃ padma shlau ka gsum la zhal gyi paṃ padma'i dbyangs rol lan gsum/ phrin 'chol shlau ka gcig la gang thugs ma thung ba'i dbyangs rol/ de ltar bla ma shlau ka gcig la mi rtog ma 'breng po myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma'i dbyangs rol/ gsang bdag bka' bstod shlau ka gsum la 'jam rdor ma'i dbyangs rol dbyangs myur du btang ba bcas/ phan bde'i dpal 'byor ma la tshig rol chems brdung sgang dung / srid zhi dpal 'byor ma 'dur shur gang rung / oṃ dpal chen ma/ dpal mgon ma hā kā la'i 'chams dbyangs rol mo/ tshogs yod na byin rlabs gong gi nang mchod bzhin la/ 'od du zhu tshogs la thim pas tshogs kha dog dri ro zhes bsgyur/ 'bul tshul mdos chen ji lta ba bzhin la/ kyai rdor gtor sngags kyi rjes su 'byung 'dul gtor sngags phur srung gtor sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ ga na pa ti sa pā ri wā ra na māḥ sogs tshogs bdag gi gtor sngags/ 'dren len longs spyod lhag gtor bcas mdos chen bzhin la 'on kyang dpon slob thams cad kyis tshogs lhag sdud/ 'di la gnod sbyin zhal sre'i tshogs 'khor lta bu'i lhag gtor mi dgos so snyam na ma yin te/ skabs 'di'i tshogs 'khor 'das gtor dang rjes 'brel la sbyar ba'i tshogs lhag byed par 'thad do/ /mjug chog gi mchod pa'i shapta la rol chen bstod pa dril bsil gdangs bcas/ cho ga sbrel nas byed tshe nyin dang po rnams la brtan bzhugs dang chabs cig 'byung 'dul tshom bu dang / bum pa'i ye shes par brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i dmigs pa byed/ grol nyin tshom bu'i ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes par/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod zhes sogs dang ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs bya'o/ /yang cho ga bsdus pa la dga' na/ bdag mdun bum gsum gyi bzlas par sumbha ni nyer gcig re/

tshogs bdag 'bru drug ma phreng 'khor/ sngags thung gzhan rnams gsum re/ sngags ring tshar gcig lha gnyis kyi bstod pa dril bsil ma rnams la gdangs thung / mchod phreng sngags bcas gdangs med/ me tog phreng ba zhes sogs mchod tshig la gdangs thung yan lag bdun pa gsum shur ma/ bskang gso'i bcom rol thugs dam ma lugs/ spyan 'dren shlau ka gsum la srin thung / de 'og shlau ka gnyis la so sor tshig rol med par rjes ma'i tshig rol chems brdung mchod phreng gi tshigs rkang bcu gsum la mgon po 'khor dang ma'i dbyangs gnyis re mos oṃ 'bras chen shlau ka gcig 'dur ma tshig rol gzhan yang mchod par dbyangs rol spu sdug dbyibs legs shlau ka gcig 'dur ma tshig rol/ de ltar mchod par dbyangs rol/ bstod pa le tshan la dbyangs rol gong bzhin/ sngon tshe thub dbang shlau ka gcig 'dur ma/ de ltar bla ma shlau ka gcig bcas la 'dur ma tshig rol/ de phyin gong bzhin no/ /zhes dpal 'byung po 'dul byed dang tshogs kyi bdag po'i mchod gtor bskang bar dbyangs rol sogs cho ga'i lag len phra mo byed tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'byung po 'dul byed dang tshogs bdag sbags sgrub kyi mchod bskang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
